# OpenClaw Discord Vault Loop

## Loop
1. human issues command/question in Discord
2. OpenClaw investigates/acts using runtime + workspace + vault/wiki context
3. result is returned conversationally
4. important result is written back into durable pages
5. future queries can retrieve it from the wiki/substrate

## Why it matters
This loop is how the system becomes cumulatively intelligent instead of stateless.
